heading: Find a tool for the next step.

jobs.title: Research companies
jobs.benefit: Look up company details from public registries.
jobs.detail: Look up company information from public registries. Available fields and country coverage depend on the tool you choose.
jobs.visual: Registry information becomes a readable company profile. Fictional example, not a live response.

jobs.title: Extract document data
jobs.benefit: Turn documents into fields your agent can use.
jobs.detail: Extract fields from documents such as invoices. Check the chosen tool’s input format and supported fields before connecting it to your workflow.
jobs.visual: A sample invoice becomes supplier and total fields. Illustrative values only.

jobs.title: Check inputs
jobs.benefit: Catch malformed inputs before the next step.
jobs.detail: Check inputs such as email addresses. Email-format, mail-record and disposable-domain checks do not guarantee that a message will reach its recipient.
jobs.visual: Two example email inputs receive different format-check results. This illustrates syntax checks, not delivery.
